newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Fairfax journalists strike over media rules.
newsitem.headline: Fairfax journalists strike over media rules.

text.p: Journalists employed by John Fairfax Holdings Ltd said they would remain off the job until late Tuesday morning after walking off the job late on Monday to protest against expected changes to media ownership rules.

Fairfax, the publisher of daily broadsheets The Sydney Morning Herald and the Melbourne Age as well as the Australian Financial Review, is mooted as a likely takeover target for billionaire businessman Kerry Packer.
Cabinet is expected to consider changes to the media rules as early as Tuesday which will allow television network owners such as Packer to also own newspapers in the same key market.

Packer, the owner of the Nine Network via his Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd, is a 15 percent shareholder in Fairfax, the maximum currently allowed under the cross-media ownership rules now in force.
Brierley Investments Ltd is the largest shareholder in Fairfax with a 20 percent stake and is prevented under foreign investment rules from owning more than 25 percent.
